title: Retagging for arbitrary normalized presentations of one tower purity adjunction
statement: Use the finite-field setting [def-pur-conventions] and interfaces [def-pur-tower-geometric-purity-data, det-sp-tower-gamma]. Let j:X to Z be open, p:Z to Y proper, f=jp smooth of pure dimension d, with X,Y separated finite-type over k and Noetherian. Fix the normalized operations, twists, constructible-support functor F, right adjoint G, adjunction, finite-level comparisons and tower purity presentation a. Then Retagging holds: for every other presentation a_gamma on the same factorization and any right adjoint G_gamma, orientation, the actual inverse-projection/counit composite, and its tensor transpose agree with those of a after the unique counit-preserving right-adjoint comparison. The tensor data in each presentation are the given arbitrary normalized data, not newly chosen tensor models.

proof.text: Unfold Retagging. Apply orientation_ground_field_retagging with the identity automorphism and the given structural maps. Scheme.Hom.isOver_iff supplies the structural equation. Specialize its tower clause to the same factorization and two arbitrary purity presentations. Faithfulness of inverse realization removes that functor and proves the orientation equation.

Apply tensor_presentation_retagging to the supplied tensor models and the same two adjunction presentations. This gives the quantified projection-counit and tensor-transpose equations, completing the conjunction.
